label: Custom Columns (Old)
purpose: Legacy multi-column layout with various content blocks distributed across columns
_notes: Custom columns is a legacy flexible layout section where blocks can be distributed across multiple columns. Each block has a 'column' setting (col_1 to col_6) to specify which column it belongs to. Use this for complex multi-column layouts. Use EXACT block names as listed in allowed_blocks above (hyphens matter): 'icon-with-text' NOT 'icon_with_text', 'rating-stars' NOT 'rating_stars', 'payment-badges' NOT 'payment_badges', 'collapsible-row' NOT 'accordion'.
